visual_action: A montage of clips primarily featuring former President Barack Obama. He is shown giving speeches at a podium, smiling, walking with Joe Biden in the White House while both wear sunglasses, interacting with a crowd and holding a baby, and walking with Kamala Harris and Gavin Newsom. Interspersed is a brief, black-and-white clip of Donald Trump and J.D. Vance. Another clip shows Joe Biden laughing and patting Obama on the back.
